### CVE-2019-0160
- Assigner: intel | Published: 2019-03-27 | Updated: 2024-08-04 | Max CVSS: 8.7
- CWE: Escalation of Privilege and/or Denial of Service; CWE-120 Buffer Copy without Checking Size of Input ('Classic Buffer Overflow')
- CVSS 3.0 (cna): 8.7 HIGH `CVSS:3.0/AV:N/AC:H/PR:N/UI:N/S:C/C:N/I:H/A:H`

Buffer overflow in system firmware for EDK II may allow unauthenticated user to potentially enable escalation of privilege and/or denial of service via network access.
